stations.title: Rosa
stations.say: This receipt is a cent off.

captions: At Cinderbay Paddle Co., Rosa finds a member's receipt that is a cent off.
The till prints a subtotal, a discount and a total that do not agree.
You catch the bug, fix the receipt and write its test, in three tasks.
Now every receipt the till prints adds up to the cent.
Same order, same till. Every line on the receipt agrees.
